text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $76k with modest gains, while Ethereum is outpacing it at +1.7%, suggesting some rotation into alt exposure despite neutral sentiment. The Fear & Greed index sits at 50 and has declined 19 points over the week, indicating cooling momentum and caution despite solid trading volume of $93B. Bitcoin dominance at 58.3% remains elevated, reflecting continued preference for the largest asset even as smaller-cap altcoins show relative strength.
